history.recommendation_text: The Board reiterates its recommendation that the Administration clearly define the functions and responsibilities of each division and service within the Office of Information and Communications Technology to avoid duplication and fragmentation within the Office.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The functions and responsibilities of each division and service are outlined in the Secretary- General’s bulletin on the organization of the Office of Information and Communications Technology (ST/SGB/2016/11) and the report of the Secretary-General entitled “Shifting the management paradigm in the United Nations: implementing a new management architecture for improved effectiveness and strengthened accountability (A/72/492/Add.2, paras. 261–274). A review of the functions and responsibilities of each division within the Office is undertaken annually in the context of preparing the proposed programme plan and budget for the Office, which are reviewed by the Committee for Programme and Coordination and the Fifth Committee respectively. The Office’s divisions and services prepare annual workplans that are centrally reviewed to ensure that there is no duplication or fragmentation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the functions and responsibilities of each division have been clearly defined, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
